author: GamingBolt
description:
For a series that's celebrating its 30th anniversary next month, I don't think we fully appreciate just how many iconic characters Resident Evil has produced. Chris Redfield, Leon S. Kennedy, Claire Redfield, Jill Valentine, Albert Wesker, Sherry Birkin – it even speaks to the development team's talents that Grace Ashcroft, whose full story remains shrouded in mystery, feels like a natural fit to that list. 

But if we're talking “mysterious,” then no one in the franchise fits that bill better than the one and only, Ada Wong.
title: The Full Story of Ada Wong - Before You Begin Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
First person shooters continue to be the favourite genre for millions of gamers worldwide, and as it’s so well-trodden the genre is full to bursting with bright ideas and gameplay variety. 

From militaristic shooters and large-scale, multi-player wars, to tactically rich sci-fi and blood curdling horror, the games on this rundown prove that anything goes in the world of first person shooters. So, step aside Call of Duty, FPS in 2026 is alive with vigour, imagination, and innovation.
title: 15 NEW First Person Shooter Games of 2026 You NEED TO PLAY

author: GamingBolt
description:
As much as the Resident Evil games are famous for the challenges they introduce us to, they're also memorable thanks to the people who choose to take a stand against the zombies. 

We've got a whole bunch of such folks who have worked with each other and alone to try and counter the threat that BOWs pose to the general public. And ahead of Grace joining their illustrious ranks with Leon bringing a fresh new approach to dealing with BOWs in Requiem, we're taking a look at a few important characters from the past, and their current place in the story.
title: Resident Evil All Main Heroes: Their Last Known Status - Before You Start Resident Evil Requiem
